scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names web,server "npm run dev --workspace=@allplay/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@allplay/server"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@allplay/shared && npm run build --workspace=@allplay/audio-sync
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@allplay/server && npm run build --workspace=@allplay/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names web,server "npm run start --workspace=@allplay/web" "npm run start --workspace=@allplay/server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.smoke:dev: npm run build:packages && node scripts/smoke.mjs dev
